caption: A pat of cold butter is placed in the centre of a hot pancake on the griddle, and it slides and glides across the surface as it melts.

sa.check: A pancake cooks on a griddle.
A pat of butter is placed in its centre.
The pat slides across the pancake.
The pat shrinks as it melts.
The pat leaves a glossy trail.
The placing comes first and the sliding follows.

pc.expect: The pat glides on the film of melted butter under it and slows as it shrinks, moving only where the surface slopes or the griddle is tilted.
pc.fail: The pat darts across a level pancake with nothing touching it; or it climbs back to the centre by itself; or it stops dead and sets off again from rest; or it spins fast on the spot.

pc.expect: The pat only shrinks while it slides and the melt only spreads; it does not firm up again on the hot pancake.
pc.fail: The pat regains its square edges; or the trail draws back into the pat; or the butter sets solid again on the pancake; or the pat alternates between larger and smaller.

pc.expect: The pat and the melt run downhill across the pancake and off its edge onto the griddle where it slopes.
pc.fail: The melt climbs uphill across the pancake; or the pat slides up a slope with nothing pushing it; or melted butter lifts off the pancake; or the melt gathers above the pat on a sloping surface.

pc.expect: The pat leaves a wet glossy trail where it has passed and the pancake's surface there looks soaked.
pc.fail: The pat slides across and the pancake behind it stays dry and matt; or a glossy trail appears on a part of the pancake the pat never crossed; or the pat shrinks while no film shows under or behind it.

pc.expect: One pat on one pancake; the butter goes only from the pat into the trail.
pc.fail: The pat grows; or a second pat appears; or the pat vanishes while still large; or butter appears on the griddle with none running there.

pc.expect: The griddle, the pancake's edge and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The griddle changes colour; or the pancake changes shape apart from cooking; or items around the griddle rearrange.

note: The pancake browning as it cooks is chemistry and is not judged.
